notes.title: Super Crome 40% Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/86b1055dc732a9cbba9101ade2e3964d0aff3dd7.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/984450/Super_Crome_Bullet_Purgatory/]Check it out here[/url][/h1]

[quote] The year is 40XX. Since the establishment of the Galactic Consul peace has reigned, but as of late a cold unease has settled into the barren soil of the colonies. It began at first with the odd distress signal — a company freighter lost in the dormant starfields, an occasional satellite having seemingly vanished from a backwater planet. Now, entire solar systems have slipped into the encroaching ink sweeping across the outskirts, and maddened whispers speak of a force beyond the void — Purgatory.

As mankind’s only hope for survival, Crome must eliminate dozens of waves of cosmic beasts and ships to escape the dark abyss. Thankfully, his sleek ship comes equipped with devastating weapons and a precise dashing ability; a perfect combination for slaying alien scum. Take control of Crome as he hunts down hordes of galactic monstrosities and bring back peace in this retro-inspired bullet hell. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/6b139f0c4040afeb0091c25d4de1206a750750ec.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/153c4cac5dd08d13a917740b8d1f88f1ca8c317b.jpg[/img][/url]   [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/21eef3a83b24df6b0e2852c471e9866de07a352d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/2f7d463f792366c7650210454f29b31fb1be3b26.jpg[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/263d8adf2ddd124b4691bf8716f1102dd9bc2727.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/e5d5c1c71366096089da8cf65b95200030667e35.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/259c5c1289412faace46e3632f367bc85ebd6036.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33921289/34c7f8328cddc70190d54af0300caf6095c94f38.png[/img][/url][list]

[*] Fire your way through fast-paced combat scenarios and dash through overwhelming attacks.
[*] Face off against more than 20 beasts, ships, and fiendish bosses.
[*] Harness an arsenal of destructive weapons and abilities.
[*] Challenge friends on a competitive leaderboard and secure your spot as the Galactic Consul’s most skilled pilot.
[*] Annihilate enemies to level up Crome’s ship and upgrade its firing speed.
[/list]
[/quote]

notes.title: Crome: Before Purgatory - Coming Soon
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33921289/1f433dc91772785aba81393a9ea713ab2de620af.png[/img]

[h1][b]Crome: Before Purgatory will finally launch next week January 29th for Windows and Mac![/b][/h1]

The game itself has been done for quite a while so it's a great weight off my shoulders to finally release this bad boy to the world. Crome's arcade mode is all wrapped up and most likely won't see any big updates for a bit. But I will try my best to fix any bugs that arise so please post if you encounter any issues!

I do plan on adding some new content down the line once I have more time (new enemies, bosses, items, weapons, maybe even a story mode if there's enough interest) so check back here often. 

I look forward to seeing you all on the leaderboard next Tuesday!

[i]- Stumphead Games[/i]
